name: PluralSpace
description: Web app with native OpenPlural v0.1 import and export, bundled media, relationships, boards, polls, and PluralSpace-specific mood preservation.
export_shape: Per-system ZIP with manifest.json, openplural.json, and media/. Whole-account exports contain account data plus one OpenPlural document per owned system.
fronting: Per-member FrontPeriod intervals with one assignment each; overlapping periods represent co-fronting. Front types are exported as status taxonomy terms.
groups_tags: Nested groups preserve parent_group_id, with memberships exported separately. Member roles and front types are represented through taxonomy.
custom_fields: Definitions and populated member values, including privacy and multiple-value metadata.
notes: Journal entries and ordinary notes share notes[] and are distinguished by extensions.kind; visibility is mapped to OpenPlural values.
chat_messages: Channels become conversations with separate messages and author_member_id. Attachments and reactions are not currently exported.
assets_privacy: Bundled media with asset metadata and SHA-256 checksums. Privacy is exported for systems, members, and custom fields; notes include visibility.

profile.name: PluralSpace
profile.summary: PluralSpace natively imports and exports OpenPlural v0.1. It supports the chat, boards, provisional relationships, and provisional polls modules. Mood history is preserved under extensions["pluralspace:moods"].

mapping.target: Member records with proxy tags, privacy, profile visibility, pinned state, and template state
FrontPeriod with one member assignment per interval; front types become status TaxonomyTerms and TaxonomyAssignments
Group with parent_group_id plus GroupMembership records

mapping.source: custom fields and custom field values

mapping.target: Note records distinguished by extensions.kind as journal or note
Conversation and ChatMessage records with member author IDs
Provisional relationships module with RelationshipType and MemberRelationship records
Provisional polls module using PluralSpace's current field interpretation
System-wide BoardPost records with extensions.kind set to thought_of_the_day
Asset records with bundled files, source references, and checksums
